proposal_set.name: aiter-dense-gqa-on
proposal_set.reason: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER is the master gate (default off in vLLM ROCm); all VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_<sub> flags are no-ops unless it is 1, which is why this must be benched as one atomic set. For a dense GQA bf16 model the submodules that actually sit on the dispatch path are LINEAR (AITER tuned GEMM wrappers for qkv/o/gate/up/down), RMSNORM (fused add+rmsnorm), and MHA (AITER flash-attn prefill, which also switches the V1 attention backend selection to ROCM_AITER_FA). MoE/MLA/fp8-block-scaled submodules are irrelevant here (no experts, not DeepSeek) so they are deliberately not set. aiter 0.1.20.post1 is installed in this image, so the kernels are present. NOTE: unverified against this build — if the master switch already defaults to 1 in 0.27.x this is a no-op rather than a regression.

proposal_set.name: full-decode-hipgraph
proposal_set.reason: At concurrency 64 with OSL 1024 the run is decode-dominated: ~64k tiny kernel launches per step-sequence, where launch overhead is a real fraction of an 8B dense forward pass on MI300X. Default piecewise graph mode leaves the attention op outside the captured graph, so every decode step still pays eager dispatch for attention plus the graph replay boundary. FULL_DECODE_ONLY captures the entire decode-only forward (attention included) as one HIP graph while leaving mixed prefill batches piecewise, which is exactly the shape a uniform-decode steady state produces. Cheap, orthogonal to proposal 1. Requires the attention backend to support full capture — if the chosen backend refuses, vLLM falls back to piecewise with a warning rather than failing.

proposal_set.name: rocm-custom-paged-attn-decode
proposal_set.reason: The ROCm V1 default for a dense GQA model is the unified Triton attention kernel, which handles prefill and decode tokens in one kernel and is therefore tuned for neither. VLLM_V1_USE_PREFILL_DECODE_ATTENTION splits them so decode can dispatch to the hand-written ROCm custom paged-attention kernel (gated by VLLM_ROCM_CUSTOM_PAGED_ATTN), which is specialised for GQA head-grouping and short query length — the dominant regime here. Atomic because the split alone does nothing if the custom PA kernel is disabled. Mutually exclusive in spirit with proposal 1's AITER MHA path, so bench separately, not stacked.
